description: This file defines a JPA AttributeConverter for the LoanSubStatus enum, enabling conversion between LoanSubStatus objects and their Integer database representations for persistence.

classes.name: LoanSubStatusConverter
classes.description: A converter that implements AttributeConverter to transform LoanSubStatus objects to Integer values for database storage and vice versa.

methods.name: convertToDatabaseColumn

methods.name: convertToEntityAttribute
methods.description: Converts an Integer from the database back to a LoanSubStatus object.
